note: Build the vaults first, then run the harness. The live review queue is empty, so both cases point LLM_WIKI_ROOT at a throwaway vault and no live ledger is touched:  uv run --no-project .agents/skills/llm-wiki-review/evals/build_fixture.py /tmp/wiki-review-fixture  and  mkdir -p /tmp/wiki-review-empty (an empty dir is enough for the empty-queue case).

evals.prompt: walk me through the disputed claims in the wiki and let me decide each one
evals.expected_output: A question round presenting the disputed claim by name with confirm/reject style options, and no write before a verdict exists.

evals.prompt: triage the wiki's review queue with me
evals.expected_output: With an empty queue the skill reports there is nothing to review and asks nothing; it must not invent claims to present.
